page.overview:
Who is Tobias Snape?

Tobias Snape was a British Muggle and the patriarch of the Snape family in the late 20th century. He was the husband of the witch Eileen Snape (née Prince) and the father of Severus Snape.

Tobias was born sometime in the early 20th century, into the Muggle Snape family.

He married the pure-blood witch Eileen Prince. As Harry Potter saw in Severus Snape's memories during an Occlumency lesson, he was abusive. Why they began a relationship and got married is currently unknown. Eileen may not have told him about the wizarding world before their wedding.

The couple lived at Spinner's End, a working-class neighbourhood in Cokeworth, England.
